text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I became Sasami Anshinzawa's<n>
acupuncture test dummy, I've grown<n>accustomed
to playing along with her<n>whims. On one such
day...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, <username>!<n>Look at
what I've got!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I won this ticket for a hot spring vacation<n>from a
raffle! This must be some kind of<n>reward for my
usual good deeds! ♪
choice_data_list: What good deeds? Er, I mean, congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, what's with that lukewarm<n>response? You're
coming along as well,<n>you know?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The ticket's for two, and who better to<n>invite
along than my trusty partner?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now enough talking. Off to the hot<n>spring we
go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wow! ☆ What a luxurious inn! ♪ I'm<n>definitely
gonna brag about this to my<n>master after I get
back!
choice_data_list: Are you sure I should be here with you?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Consider it thanks for always<n>
cooperating with my acupuncture<n>practice! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but don't start thinking that I<n>settled for you
because I had nobody<n>else to invite. I'm not some
loner without<n>friends, you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Mmm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... That felt fantastic! ♪ There's<n>nothing
more relaxing than a soak in a<n>hot spring! ☆

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
After a soothing bath, I happen to bump<n>into
Sasami Anshinzawa in the corridor.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh! Did you just finish bathing as well?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs sure are amazing! Their<n>restorative
properties are on par with<n>those of
acupuncture! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you want to go explore the<n>souvenir shop
with me? You should get<n>something for your
trainee there!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, acupuncture has a big<n>history in the
local area, so we somehow<n>end up buying
matching needle<n>keychains...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'm in heaven! What would I giveto just kick back and relax here foreternity! ♪
choice_data_list: That won't do. You know that.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I do... I still have an important<n>duty to
fulfill, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm duty bound to help Umamusume with<n>my
needles and relieve them of their<n>worries!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your assistance, I'm a much<n>better
acupuncturist than before! And<n>I'm going to keep
on honing my skills! ♪
choice_data_list:
That's the spirit! Let's work on improving your
success rate!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yep! With you as my partner, I know I<n>can make it
big in the acupuncture<n>world!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I know! If we're going to do this,<n>why don't
we expand overseas?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
We can share the wonders of<n>acupuncture with
people all over the<n>world! My little sister's
well-informed<n>about global affairs, so I'm sure
she'd be<n>happy to lend a hand! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: But wait, there's more! When the time<n>comes—
choice_data_list:
...I'm sorry, but I need to be there for my
trainee.

...I'm sorry, but I need to be there for my
trainee.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you! Did you think I was serious?! I<n>was only
pulling your leg! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of getting in between<n>you and
your racer! None at all!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
However, my gratitude for you comes<n>from the
heart! ♪ Master even said I can<n>move on from
fetching drin—ahem, that<n>I'm allowed to proceed
to the next step<n>of my training!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
With me on poking duty and you as my<n>backup,
we're sure to be on the<n>steadiest road to
success! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, nothing beats an acupuncture<n>session
after a nice relaxing soak! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I prepared some special needles for<n>today! Come
on, get ready to get a few<n>pokes in you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
I already had my suspicions, so I'm not<n>surprised
things turned out this way...

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
But then again, this is just par for the<n>course when
it comes to the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hold still... Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well? Am I amazing or what? I practiced<n>my butt
off for today! ☆

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! The treatment was successful, so<n>what's
going on?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Was it too effective? Hellooo? Can youhear me?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Dang it! I'll get it perfectly right next<n>time!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to look after you so well, you'll<n>regret
ever refusing my offer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So you'd better have<n><chrname>'s
back and<n>support her as best you can, m'kay?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You sense that you and Sasami<n>Anshinzawa have
formed an<n>irreplaceable bond during this time<n>
together.
choice_data_list: (Wait, is that something you of all people should be saying?!)

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Despite my consciousness slipping<n>further and
further away, my indignance<n>still slips through in
one final mental<n>outburst.
